forge-1.4.3.min.js is the browser bundle taken from Moonlight-CivSwitch.
Its existing RNG, URL compatibility and RSA scheduling adaptations are retained
in that source snapshot. None of its RSA, TLS or random generators are used here.

forge-aes.js is generated by tools/build_crypto_subset.cjs from that exact
SHA-256-pinned source. It includes only the AES/cipher/mode/utility dependency
graph, preserving original module bodies. A factory-local setImmediate adapter
uses timers so loading the utility module cannot install persistent page message
listeners or DOM observers. AES is synchronous and does not use those timers.

CivChiaki uses this subset only as a portable fallback and independent regression
path. On the supported console SDK, the native provider performs bulk AES and
GMAC. No CDN, npm installation, TLS stack or RSA code is loaded at runtime.
